name: Animated Bento Showcase
description: Fluid em-scaled 3-column bento of feature cards with living micro-scenes: a looping payment-pill carousel on a dark card, a floating coin cluster, a tilted product-image stack on a dark card, and a typing secure-checkout field, flanking a tall center phone with a skeleton and a poly headline.
interactions: the whole bento scales in em off a fluid root font-size clamp(13px,1.652vw,28.55px) so it grows/shrinks as one unit
connect card: payment pills carousel every 2600ms with verbatim wpmn-abs-pill-in (0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.3,1)) / pill-out (0.4s ease) and a synced active dot
account card: four coins bob (wpmn-abs-bob) on staggered 4-5s loops
collect card: product-image stack sways (wpmn-abs-sway 6s) at fixed -11.6/+11.8/-25.1deg rotations
privacy card: checkout field types password dots every 420ms with a blinking caret (wpmn-abs-blink 1.1s steps(1))
carousel + typing run off a shared rAF tick plus a 1s setInterval so backgrounded tabs still advance
below 900px the phone hides and the grid goes 2-col; below 540px 1-col; prefers-reduced-motion freezes all micro-scenes in a settled state
